**Finding: deviation (medium) — Section 19.2 warranty duration.**

The warranty package is otherwise strong and needs no change:
- **19.1** – professional and workmanlike performance by qualified personnel plus material conformity to documentation and specifications.
- **19.3** – no malicious code, compliance with Applicable Law, no functionality diminution, open-source protection.
- **19.4** – re-perform/repair/replace, escalating to termination and refund, and expressly **non-exclusive** for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims.
- **19.5** – disclaimer is mutual and expressly does **not** limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy, so it does not swallow 19.1–19.3.

The one gap is duration: Deliverables (which under §1.4 and §13.2 include configurations, integrations and embedded software) carry only a 90-day conformance window against our preferred 12 months for software. Hosted Services already conform for the full subscription term, so the minimal redline is a single-phrase change in 19.2 from "ninety days" to "twelve months", with 90 days retained as the fallback for non-software work product. Redline validated (ok:true) and finding submitted.
